title: moderation_item
description: A flagged creative or question bank in the human queue (YT-0114).

businessId.description: NOT required: TASKS.md 9.2.a's staff moderation queue names no single business in its URL (a list has none at all; approve/reject name a campaignId, not a businessId) -- same reasoning as voucher_batch.json's own comment. Cerbos runs with enforcement: reject, so requiring it would fail schema validation, and therefore deny, every staff moderation route before any rule ran.

hasReason.description: An approve or reject with no reason is not a decision anyone can audit, so the PDP refuses it.
